partial_progress.details: SPIKE reached verdict (b) NOT CLEANLY ABSTRACTABLE. Verified constructor sigs for PL/Modal/Bimodal derivation trees, the InferenceSystem class, algebraicDerivationSystem/ListDeriv, and all three lift bodies directly from source. Recommend BLOCKED; no sorry.

blockers.title: Axiom-subsumption derivation lift is not cross-logic abstractable as specified
blockers.summary: Bimodal has no axiom predicate (fc-parameterized over concrete Axiom inductive); its liftDerivationWith is conservative-extension unembedding, not axiom subsumption. The InferenceSystem/algebraicDerivationSystem seam (ListDeriv) omits necessitation by design and cannot host a lift that must recurse through it. Three distinct formula types/constructor sets (4/5/7). One lift for all three is infeasible without an XL syntax unification.
